description: Military-grade cyber-amphetamine. The label is mostly warnings.

effects.onset_message: Your heart finds the new gear and stays there.

overdose.message: Your heart is a fist clenching until it can't open again.

phases.comedown_message: The wire goes slack. Your hands start to shake.
phases.comeup_message: Your pulse redlines. The world drops into slow motion.
phases.end_message: The crash lands on you like a dropped ceiling.
phases.peak_message: You're made of wire and lightning. Nothing can touch you.

effects.take_line: You dose {name}, the way the label tells you not to.

withdrawal.message: Your teeth won't stop grinding. You need another hit.

stages.easing: The world comes back up to its own speed, which turns out to have been the speed the whole time.
stages.onset: Your teeth find each other and start working.
stages.peak: Your heart has been going for no reason since you sat down, and sitting down was supposed to be the answer.
stages.rising: Everything is slow. The lift, the door, the person in front of you, all of it, and none of it actually is.
stages.tail: Baseline. It reads as slow because you have spent a fortnight being wrong about what fast is.

name: Redline
